title: Delete Committed Binaries Over 100MB
description: Binary files larger than 100MB were committed. Find every such blob reachable from commits and delete those files from the tree and from history so they are no longer in the repository.
summary: Removed three Mach-O binaries over 100MB. They lived only in amended-away commits and an unreachable pack blob. Reflog pointers to those commits were dropped and git gc --prune=now deleted the blobs. HEAD has no file larger than 100MB.
